instruction: I need to prepare a shorter version of the presentation in LibreOffice Impress. Please hide slide 11 ("Writing") from the slideshow without deleting it.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires hiding a slide. The evaluator checks if slide 11 (index 10) has the hidden property set. LibreOffice Impress stores this in presentation XML. Original slide 11 has title "Writing".

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic error: Getter searches for 'show' attribute in wrong XML location (individual slide files)
Hidden slides in PPTX are marked in '/ppt/presentation.xml' under '<p:sldIdLst>' with 'show="0"' attribute on '<p:sldId>' elements, not in individual slide XML files
Current getter logic checks '<p:sld>' and '<p:cSld>' elements in 'ppt/slides/slideN.xml' which do not contain the 'show' attribute
This will cause the getter to always return False, failing to detect hidden slides correctly
Slide index (10) is correctly mapped to slide 11 (1-based)
Postconfig correctly saves the file before verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to parse '/ppt/presentation.xml' instead of individual slide XML files
Search for '<p:sldId>' elements within '<p:sldIdLst>' and check the 'show' attribute
Use the slide's 'r:id' relationship to map slide_index to the correct '<p:sldId>' element
Example logic: Parse presentation.xml -> find sldIdLst -> get sldId by index -> check show attribute
Alternative: Use python-pptx library's slide.element.get('{...}show') if available, though presentation.xml is the canonical location
